fun_run.title: Rotterdam Fun Run
fun_run.subtitle: Fundraiser for HK Masters Hockey
fun_run.description: Join us for a fun run through the streets of Rotterdam! All proceeds go towards the HK Masters Hockey team fund. Whether you're a serious runner or just want a great morning out with the team, all abilities welcome.

tournament_archive.name: WMH | 2024 Masters World Cup | Auckland, New Zealand
tournament_archive.location: National Hockey Centre, Auckland, New Zealand
tournament_archive.description:
WMH is thrilled with the number of registered teams for the WMH World Cup, 2024. 113 teams registered for Cape Town and 141 for Auckland, including 33 International Masters Cup teams. We were there with our Hong Kong Masters MO50 team. We had an awesome time!

View all the Auckland matches here (free login required): **https://www.worldmastershockey.tv/en/home**

tournament_archive.name: WMH Asia Championship 2025
tournament_archive.description: HK Masters hosted the World Masters Hockey Asia Championship 2025 here in Hong Kong. The full tournament site includes match schedules, visitor information, results, and all the details from this landmark event.
